rules: The family/profile matrix is VirtualAstrometryFixture.Families and VirtualAstrometryFixture.Profiles at the measured revision, frozen in docs/astronomy/virtual-astrometry-qualification-v2.md before any tuning or held-out measurement. HVO_PROJECTION_FAMILY selects one family per process; an unknown name fails the run.

Every final run executes at one committed, clean revision built in Release; HVO_EVIDENCE_REVISION must equal that revision and each harness that checks the assembly InformationalVersion must accept it.

Tuning runs are not final evidence. They execute only the tuning partitions and exist so that the declared fallback decision, and any coordinator-approved algorithmic fix, are made before held-out data is seen. Held-out runs are never used to change a profile, the solver, a floor or a tolerance.

Seeds, sky times, readouts, partitions and numerical tolerances are those compiled into each #1102/#1103/#1104/#1105 harness, unchanged by this issue. Each harness source blob id is recorded in the evidence index.

Declared fallback: if the 6 mm rectilinear profile fails a tuning harness, a commit made before any held-out run replaces 'rectilinear' with 'rectilinear-8mm' in the final perProcess values and records the tuning failure. The fallback is not used for any other reason, and a held-out failure is never followed by the fallback.
A held-out failure of a family is retained and published as a named software gap with an unsupported disposition for that family. It is not retried, tuned against or excluded from the pack.

Every run must execute exactly expectedPassed tests, with zero failed and zero not-executed tests, in a fresh results directory, and must attach exactly one file named like each listed report. A run that matches no test fails the qualification.
Runs are sequential on an otherwise idle host. Docker is not required. The equidistant family is the #1106 regression baseline and is compared numerically with the #1106 evidence.
